title_zh: 约定保留虚构诉讼的两项未决问题

scenario.label_zh: 约定保留虚构诉讼的两项未决问题
scenario.goal_zh: 区分法院管辖争议与责任认定，并约定摘要分别说明两者尚未解决

context_zh: 两位学生讨论虚构民事案件练习材料，只核对给定信息，不推断真实法律结论。
author: author-phase11-b

sentences.speaker: Nell
sentences.text: Can I say the company is liable now that the lawsuit has been filed?

sentences.speaker: Arun
sentences.text: No. Filing the case isn't the same as deciding it. What else does our fictional case sheet say?

sentences.speaker: Nell
sentences.text: The company disputes the court's jurisdiction, and the court hasn't answered that challenge.

sentences.speaker: Arun
sentences.text: Does it record any decision about responsibility for the damage?

sentences.speaker: Nell
sentences.text: No, it says that question is still unresolved too.

sentences.speaker: Arun
sentences.text: Then give them separate lines: jurisdiction disputed, and liability not decided.

sentences.speaker: Nell
sentences.text: Agreed. I'll remove the sentence saying the company has already been found responsible.
